poc_workflow.display_name: 1. Record ordinary movement and camera control
instructions: Confirm the editable bindings below against the current in-game settings.
Start in a safe open area with the normal gameplay UI and mini-map visible.
After the automatic countdown begins, take a short cruise using ordinary movement and camera control together.

poc_workflow.display_name: 2. Slowly turn the view horizontally through at least 360 degrees
poc_workflow.confirmation_label: the stationary view turns slowly through at least one full revolution
instructions: Stand still in a visually textured, safe location.
Turn the camera slowly in one horizontal direction through at least 360 degrees.
Do not move the character, reverse direction, or add vertical camera motion.

poc_workflow.display_name: 3. Rotate the camera while standing still
poc_workflow.confirmation_label: camera rotates while the character stays still
instructions: Stand still in the same safe open area with the mini-map visible.
When recording starts, rotate the camera smoothly without pressing a movement key.

poc_workflow.display_name: 4. Move in several directions without turning the camera
poc_workflow.confirmation_label: several movement directions are visible with no camera turn
instructions: Keep the camera completely still.
Move in several directions with brief stops so the cursor exposes its pivot and heading changes.

poc_workflow.confirmation_label: one straight forward run produces a notable mini-map shift
instructions: Face into a long, safe, unobstructed path and keep the camera completely still.
When recording starts, hold forward and run far enough to create a clearly visible mini-map shift.
Do not turn the camera or steer during the segment.

poc_workflow.confirmation_label: all accessible map regions and layers were covered
instructions: Open the full in-game map viewer.
Use a zoom level with more effective detail than the mini-map.
For this first evidence take, pan systematically with generous overlap and visit every accessible region/layer.
Pause briefly at coverage boundaries and note locked or undiscovered areas after the take.

poc_workflow.confirmation_label: one complete map-selected teleport reaches the destination world
instructions: Begin in normal gameplay with the current position visible on the mini-map.
After recording starts, open the global map, click one teleport target, and confirm the teleport.
Do not stop recording during loading; wait until normal gameplay is fully visible at the destination.
The later analyzer will retain the selected target and observed destination in the canonical global-map coordinate space.
Choose one safe, short, repeatable non-combat route and use the same start state for every take.
Run 1 is the reference demonstration; later runs are held out.
Play naturally without recorder hotkeys or authoring actions.
Confirm each full take after returning to the workbench.

limitations: This profile is a human-confirmed POC draft; bindings may differ in the selected account and must be reviewed.
Short calibration captures are labeled by their selected capture plan; confirmation only checks that the requested motion is visible.
Use a safe non-combat area and do not circumvent game security or anti-cheat systems.

ordinary_cruise: normal cursor turn-rate and angular-acceleration distribution
runtime temporal-search envelope with source provenance
rotation_only: screen-fixed cursor shape and polar template
movement_only: cursor centroid orbit and rotation center
cursor-pivot-centered polar pose and Gaussian-fit validation
forward_no_turn: cursor heading to observed mini-map shift direction
